criteria.requirement: Repair CallbackIOWrapper write reporting: call the actual stream first, use a valid integer-index result as successful count, including zero and short writes, then invoke callback exactly once and return the unchanged original result. Binary buffer capacity uses memoryview.nbytes, text capacity uses character len. Reject bool/non-index/negative/over-capacity returned counts without progress callback; None retains explicitly documented legacy len(data) fallback. A stream write error never advances progress and the wrapper never retries short writes or closes/rewinds caller streams. Preserve the existing read reporting path.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
